# CS50

> Harvard's premier free introductory computer science course covering programming fundamentals, web development, and data science with verified certificates available through edX.

CS50 is Harvard University's flagship computer science course offered through edX and Harvard Extension School, designed for beginners with no prior programming experience. The course combines traditional classroom instruction with self-paced online learning, making world-class computer science education accessible globally.

## Main Courses

- [CS50x 2026](https://cs50.harvard.edu/x/): CS50x 2026: Harvard's free intro to CS course covering C, Python, SQL, and web development.
- [CS50 on edX](http://cs50.harvard.edu/): CS50 on edX: Harvard's free computer science courses with certificates and self-paced learning.
